title: Neuro-Kurisu SUPER — reconciled weighted implementation roadmap scorecard — WorkPass52
method: WorkPass52 fixes project-progress integrity: verified but underqualified outcomes no longer close steps or promote skills, evidence-qualified attempts persist across restart, invalid gate outcomes are not consumed as final project receipts, and a sanitized live project plan is displayed through the active-project API/Runtime Atlas. Browser build/E2E and real provider/device validation remain open; no readiness increase is claimed.

workstreams.name: Canonical source lineage and single-owner architecture
workstreams.rationale: Single writable organism state/memory authorities preserved. WorkPass39 adds a read-only cognitive ownership map and typed flow validation without parallel runtime state.

workstreams.name: Runtime integration, API/UI routes and smoke/linkage coverage
workstreams.rationale: Runtime API and Runtime Atlas now surface the brain map and live composed-system health; routes and focused UI linkage are wired. Dependency-installed React/Vite and interactive browser Live2D E2E remain open.

workstreams.name: Memory 2.0, retrieval/admission and benchmark evidence
workstreams.rationale: Memory admission now respects net utility, harm/redundancy and provenance even without budget pressure. Independent labelled temporal holdout remains open and retrieval uplift is still zero.

workstreams.name: Agency, action schema, execution, outcome and reafference
workstreams.rationale: Cycle-local lineage checks now gate completion in runtime and core feedback; durable ActionGateway receipts remain. Real provider/device receipts and reconnect/replay remain open.

workstreams.name: Portable subject continuity and social/known-entity dossier
workstreams.rationale: Unified cycle verification is tied to actual same-tick causal edges; this improves continuity evidence but is not a claim of subjective consciousness.

workstreams.name: External transport, SDK, idempotency and replay
workstreams.rationale: Stable IDs for new evidence and legacy ID continuity are improved; external transport delivery receipts/reconnect and multi-provider reconciliation remain open.

workstreams.name: Research promotion and controlled experiments
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass40 reviews the existing source archives and upstream contracts, adds SBOM/provenance inventory, and adapts the documented OpenAI-compatible llama.cpp endpoint into the existing P40 model ecology. External source clones and target-hardware inference remain pending where network or target hardware is unavailable.

workstreams.name: Release durability: build, E2E, rollback, soak, SBOM/provenance
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass40 adds an atomic lock-guarded exact-set restore with checksum staging, symlink rejection, rollback staging and nine state-backup tests; SBOM/provenance covers 464 locked npm components and ten embedded source archives. Full fault-injected clean-room rollback, installed Vite build, browser E2E, manual license sign-off and soak remain open.
